# [postcss][postcss]-merge-rules [![Build Status](https://example.invalid/ben-eb/postcss-merge-rules.svg?branch=master)][ci] [![NPM version](https://example.invalid/js/postcss-merge-rules.svg)][npm] [![Dependency Status](https://example.invalid/ben-eb/postcss-merge-rules.svg)][deps]

> Merge CSS rules with PostCSS.

## Install

With [npm](https://example.invalid/package/postcss-merge-rules) do:

```
npm install postcss-merge-rules --save
```

## Examples

This module will attempt to merge *adjacent* CSS rules:

### By declarations

#### Input

```css
a {
    color: blue;
    font-weight: bold
}

p {
    color: blue;
    font-weight: bold
}
```

#### Output

```css
a,p {
    color: blue;
    font-weight: bold
}
```

### By selectors

#### Input

```css
a {
    color: blue
}

a {
    font-weight: bold
}
```

#### Output

```css
a {
    color: blue;
    font-weight: bold
}
```

### By partial declarations

#### Input

```css
a {
    font-weight: bold
}

p {
    color: blue;
    font-weight: bold
}
```

#### Output

```css
a,p {
    font-weight: bold
}

p {
    color: blue
}
```

## Usage

See the [PostCSS documentation](https://example.invalid/postcss/postcss#usage) for
examples for your environment.
